paragraphs: On Friday, four friends sat under a big tree on the school field. They were Lily, Mia, Leo, and May. It was the last break before the weekend. The tree was big and green, and the grass was dry. "What do you do on Saturday?" asked Lily. "I go to the funfair with my dad," said Leo. "I want to go on the big wheel."

"Where is the funfair?" asked May. "It is in the town, next to the river," said Leo. "Is it a big funfair?" asked Lily. "Yes, it has a big wheel and a small train," said Leo. "Do you want to come, Mia?" asked Leo. "No, thank you," said Mia. "I go shopping with my mom." "We go to the market in the morning." "Then we go home and play with Snow."

"Tom and I go to the post office with Dad," said Lily. "We post a card to Aunt Sue in Chiang Mai." "We go at ten o'clock," said Lily. "Then we take Pip to the park." "Pip likes the park," said Leo. "And you, May?" asked Mia.

"I go to the library with Pat," said May. "My mom works there." "I want to improve my English." "Your English is good already," said Leo. "I want it to be better," said May. "Can I come on Sunday?" asked Mia. "Yes, of course," said May. "On Sunday we can read a book together." "Every weekend is a small adventure," said Lily. On Monday, the four friends sat under the tree again. Each one had a story from the weekend.
